in_marathi.name: Sanketraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanketraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sanketraj is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘संकेत्’ (Sanket) which means ‘sound, message, warning, signal, omen, or a sign’. The suffix ‘Raj’ is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘राज’ (Raj) which means ‘king, ruler, or a monarch’.
